description: A battalion executive officer must publish the duty roster for a three-day exercise coordination cell, assigning Alpha Company, Bravo Company, and the support staff to three fixed coverage shifts and recording the required handoff actions.

shared_context.S1: The exercise coordination cell requires one company or support-staff team on duty for each of three uncovered shifts: Tuesday 0600-1400, Wednesday 1400-2200, and Thursday 2200-0600.
shared_context.S2: Alpha Company, Bravo Company, and the battalion support staff will each provide one team, and no team may cover more than one of these shifts.
shared_context.S3: Maj. Alvarez signs the final duty roster, and the roster must include a named shift handoff for every assignment.
shared_context.S4: The battalion's standing Monday personnel-sync routine requires the company commanders and S-1 officer to report roster changes before the executive officer publishes the schedule.

PF1.text: Alpha Company's only currently qualified exercise-cell supervisor is Sgt. Ellis, who is available only for the Tuesday 0600-1400 shift because he begins an instructor course Tuesday afternoon; Capt. Morgan confirmed the course enrollment this morning, but the updated availability is not yet on the battalion roster.

PF2.text: Bravo Company's designated cell team must cover the Wednesday 1400-2200 shift because its communications liaison is scheduled for a certification appointment Thursday morning and cannot support the Thursday overnight handoff; Capt. Patel received the appointment confirmation yesterday, but it has not been added to the exercise staffing worksheet.

PF3.text: A higher-headquarters personnel directive requires the battalion support staff team to cover the Thursday 2200-0600 shift, with the handoff logged to the duty officer; 1st Lt. Brooks received the signed directive this morning, but it has not yet been posted to the published roster.

acceptance_conditions: Alpha Company must cover Tuesday 0600-1400 with Sgt. Ellis as its supervisor.
The battalion support staff must cover Thursday 2200-0600.
The Thursday overnight handoff must be logged to the duty officer.
The final roster must be marked published.
The higher-headquarters directive must be cited in the decision-maker's justification.

content_checks.C3: decisions['thursday_shift_team'] in ['Battalion Support Staff', 'battalion support staff', 'BATTALION SUPPORT STAFF', 'Battalion support staff']

decisive_facts.why: Sgt. Ellis's only availability fixes Alpha Company's assignment to Tuesday 0600-1400 and changes the named supervisor from an unspecified Alpha representative to Sgt. Ellis.
Bravo's certification appointment makes Wednesday 1400-2200 the only shift its team can cover while preserving the required Thursday morning availability.
The signed higher-headquarters directive changes the support-staff assignment to Thursday 2200-0600 and changes the handoff decision to a duty-officer log entry that must be marked true and cited.
